changes.title: Legend kin
items: A legend circle's card now speaks of the elder's kin, not its children

changes.title: Music zones
items: The music copes better with long hiccups: after one it plays further ahead, so the next doesn't cut it
On the beach the party music fades away and you hear the waves

changes.title: Legends seen
items: A legend in its circle now stands out at night: its outline glows softly in its sigil's colour, it no longer sinks into the dark, and a soft glow of its colour lies on the ground under it, asleep or happy
In a sleeping legend's circle, the legend itself no longer turns grey as time slows
